dialogues.speaker: Seiji
dialogues.jp:
「次の『うらさぶる心さまねし久かたの天のし
　ぐれの流らふ見れば』の意味は……」
dialogues.en:
"Next, the meaning of "My loud heart which cuts through
eternity and heavens"...."
dialogues.text:
"Next, the meaning of "My loud heart which cuts through
eternity and heavens"...."

dialogues.jp: 教科書片手に、湯川先生が歌の説明をする。
dialogues.en:
Holding a textbook in one hand, Yukawa-sensei explained the
meaning of the song to us.
dialogues.text:
Holding a textbook in one hand, Yukawa-sensei explained the
meaning of the song to us.

dialogues.jp: 雑談のない静かな授業。
dialogues.en: The lesson was free of distractions.
dialogues.text: The lesson was free of distractions.

dialogues.jp: ｛わ／侘｝び｛さ／寂｝びはあるが、刺激は少ない。
dialogues.en: Her hypnotic rambling was starting to make me drowsy.
dialogues.text: Her hypnotic rambling was starting to make me drowsy.

dialogues.jp:
こういう授業は退屈で、眠くなる。百人一首の
カルタ大会とかは面白いんだけどね。
dialogues.en:
With this sort of tedium, I really do feel like sleeping.
Even a Hyakunin Isshu card battle would be more interesting
than this.
dialogues.text:
With this sort of tedium, I really do feel like sleeping.
Even a Hyakunin Isshu card battle would be more interesting
than this.

dialogues.jp:
春が本格的に近づいてきた空気の中、授業終了
までゆったりと時計の針が進む。
dialogues.en:
With the full flow of spring in the air, I set my watch for
the end of the lesson.
dialogues.text:
With the full flow of spring in the air, I set my watch for
the end of the lesson.

dialogues.jp: 講師の手により浪々と、｛うた／詩｝が詠まれる。
dialogues.en: The teacher was explaining some old Japanese poem.
dialogues.text: The teacher was explaining some old Japanese poem.
